build_mujoban_pad_entity: build a MujobanPad floor pad entity with custom size, color, and detection tolerance for Mujoban tasks
register_box_with_pad: register a box entity with a MujobanPad so the pad detects when the box steps on it
check_pad_activated: check if a MujobanPad is currently activated by reading its activated property during simulation
get_activator_box: get the activator box currently pressing a MujobanPad using the activator property
reset_mujoban_pad: reset a MujobanPad to its unactivated state and restore its default color using the reset method
